name: Studtriumph
description: Strike with the lead brass from the high perch, the rear fist kept back like a folded wing.

name: Vigor Palmbar
description: Slide a pace along the ground without lowering the perch, keeping the eyes steady on the target.

name: Consecrated Bandarch
description: Hold both fists close to the brow and throat so that the forearms take whatever comes.

name: Slabbanner
description: Hook the curled brass in from the side like a talon, with a pulse of qi at the end of the arc.

name: Ringpledge
description: Brush the incoming fist away with the outer edge of the forearm as lightly as a feather turns a breath.

name: Commanding Overhand
description: Close both rings over the opponent's wrist and hold the arm locked against the chest.

name: Fearless Brawl
description: Stab the charged boss into the one gap the opponent's guard leaves between elbow and ribs.

name: Symphonic Brassrim
description: Perch, step and stoop in one linked sequence so each move covers the opening of the next.

name: Seasonbrawl
description: Vanish from the perch and reappear above the guard with both fists already falling.

name: Squall Brassring
description: The school's finishing stoop, taught to every student of the course, lands both brass fists on the guard marked open.

name: Knuckdecree
description: Jab with one fist while the other rests ready beside it, the pair pooled low in the stance.

name: Studodyssey
description: Step up onto the ledge of a stance with both knees bent and the weight settled down.

name: Ringtroth
description: Cup both fists before the body in a matched guard like the two hands of a bowl.

name: Pealknuck
description: Press the opponent's wrist down with the brass as they raise it, spilling the force from their swing.

name: Thunderclap Hooking
description: Swing a hook from the pooled stance with the other fist waiting behind to follow.

name: Peal Studplate
description: Receive a blow in the cupped guard and let its force spill back out through the other fist.

name: Authoritative Fistbar
description: Squeeze the opponent's arm between both brass fists like water held between two palms.

name: Nightmare Knockout
description: Sink the lead fist as if drawing from a well, then rise with the rear one at the face.

name: Vacuum Knuckleplate
description: Drive both bosses into a single point so two flows of qi meet at the guard.

name: Destiny Ringband
description: Let a slow tide of blows rise from jab to hook to cross with qi swelling at every step.

name: Thunderclap Handfill
description: Surge the whole pooled field into the rear cross so it lands with the weight of both hands.

name: Splendid Knuckleplate
description: The school's flood blow, drilled by every student, empties both pooled fists through one hammer fall.

name: Matchless Knuckleridge
description: Lead with a flowing straight that begins at the hip and runs out smoothly to the ring.

name: Knuckboon
description: Cross an opponent's line in two careful steps, testing the footing as at a ford.

name: Steadfast Brassrim
description: Keep the fists moving in a gentle current before the body so no blow meets a still target.

name: Vigor Haymaker
description: Cut across the stream of the opponent's guard with a hook that flows round it.

name: Squall Studplate
description: Swirl the forearm in a small eddy so the punch spins past and loses its force.

name: Masterful Ringband
description: Lay the palm bar across the opponent's forearm like a sandbar and press until their push stalls.

name: Thunderclap Overhand
description: Throw short fast blows like water over stones, each dropping qi into the brass.

name: Steel Uppercut
description: Drive the boss at the narrowest part of the guard as a stream breaks a weir.

name: Knuckcrown
description: Branch a single jab into several blows like a river at its mouth, each seeking a different opening.

name: Studedict
description: Hold the field behind the shoulder for several breaths, then open it all at once through the fist.

name: Pall Palmbar
description: The court's signature answer, turning an opponent's force along the arm and sending it back through the brass.

name: Knuckbanner
description: Open with a cross from the rear ring while the lead hand sets the measure of the distance.

name: Feather Uppercut
description: Pivot on the ball of the lead foot to face the new line of the opponent's attack.

name: Unyielding Brassring
description: Hold the ringed hands level before the face and keep the elbows evenly spaced.

name: Imperious Knuckleridge
description: Tap the ring on the opponent's elbow at the top of their swing so the arm loses its line.

name: Unrivaled Brawl
description: Knock the guard down with the first ring and strike the exposed jaw with the second.

name: Squall Handfill
description: Catch the opponent's punch on one ring and strike over it with the other.

name: Thrall Knockout
description: Seat the opponent's arm against their own side with both rings and hold it there.

name: Venomstud
description: Strike off the opponent's rhythm with a pulsed blow that leaves their timing in two parts.

name: Brawlbanner
description: Pierce the guard with a boss driven by both shoulders and charged with full-meridian qi.

name: Haymaker Edict
description: Let the rings fall one after the other in a cascade, each blow opening the way for the next.

name: Fistbar Banner
description: Set the field around the ring so the blow strikes with the weight of iron beyond its size.

name: Commanding Bandarch Reliquary
description: The court's sealing stroke, taught to its masters, shuts the lead arm to use with a ring blow.

name: Quenched Brawl
description: Jab from the high stance so the qi field's edge brushes the target an instant before the brass.

name: Surging Knuckleplate
description: Rise on the toes and take one long pace along the line of the strike.

name: Brassrim Troth
description: Hold the fists high and let the field curve over the head like a dome.

name: Haemal Knuckleridge
description: Swing a wide hook with a short tongue of the field beyond the knuckles to lengthen its arc.

name: Peal Handfill
description: Ride a draft of the field up the forearm to flick an incoming fist off its line.

name: Pealbrawl
description: Rap the boss on the seam of the opponent's own field so their cover gutters.

name: Prism Hooking
description: Bore the charged boss through the opponent's guard with the field pressing behind it.

name: Grand Brassring
description: Climb through three blows to the zenith of the stance and close with the fall of the fourth.

name: Season Fistbar
description: Vanish from one edge of the field and land a cross at the other before the eye follows.

name: Squall Hooking
description: The school's finishing blow gathers the field at the zenith and brings it down through the brass in one fall.

name: Valiant Studplate
description: Jab with both fists in turn, each fed from the same steady centre of qi.

name: Delugeknuck
description: Turn the stance about the Core as an axle and step to the new line.

name: Prismknuck
description: Hold the ringed fists before the chest with qi streaming steadily down both arms from the Core.

name: Royal Palmbar
description: Send a hook along each track in turn, each pulsed with qi drawn straight from the Core.

name: Ringband Reliquary
description: Push a pulse from the Core to the forearm so an incoming blow is thrown off the line.

name: Sigil Overhand
description: Close both rings on the opponent's arm and hold it in a grip fed by steady Core qi.

name: Ruling Knockout
description: Rap the brass in time with the Core's beat to spoil the opponent's own timing.

name: Pulsar Handfill
description: Drive the boss forward on a lance of Core qi that bores through the guard's weakest seam.

name: Tenetbrawl
description: Alternate the twin fists in a steady sequence with the Core feeding each in its turn.

name: Steel Knockout
description: Feed a full measure of Core qi into the cross so the brass rends the guard it meets.

name: Imperial Bandarch Banner
description: The school's closing stroke drives both tracks into one point of the guard and collapses it.

name: Quenched Uppercut
description: Throw a straight with the first word of the oath on the breath, the brass landing on the last.

name: Deluge Knuckleridge
description: Step with the wind at the back and let it add a half pace to the stride.

name: Steelring
description: Raise the dusters in a cover sworn not to drop until the exchange ends.

name: Paritystud
description: Knock an incoming fist aside as wind knocks a leaf, with a short flick of the wrist.

name: Quenched Haymaker
description: Swing the sworn hook out of the guard with a pulse of qi at the moment the oath is spoken.

name: Studpledge
description: Turn the body about the held line as a blow passes and answer with the rear fist.

name: Sigilslab
description: Close both dusters round the opponent's wrist and hold it as the wind holds a flag taut.

name: Studplate Reliquary
description: Rap the brass on the arm the opponent has sworn to strike with, knocking the blow off its mark.

name: Steelbrawl
description: Run in behind the boss in one long sworn step and bury its point in the guard.

name: Orchestral Uppercut
description: Send blows after one another like a train of wind, each given its own spoken word of the oath.

name: Vigor Fistbar
description: Release a gust of the field through the brass in one blow that breaks any low guard.

name: Steel Palmbar
description: The academies' vow-blow, taught to each sworn student, lands the brass exactly where the oath names.

name: Vigorring
description: Jab from the rim of the plateau with the lead foot braced on the edge.

name: Wraithlike Bandarch
description: Step along the edge in a long glide, never putting the foot where the ground ends.

name: Undefiled Ringband
description: Spread the fists wide at the rim of the stance so blows meet brass and not body.

name: Inferno Haymaker
description: Hook along the rim of the opponent's guard where the swing meets the least resistance.

name: Slabtroth
description: Hold the bearing through a parry and return the blow along it before the opponent resets.

name: Thunderclap Brassrim
description: Lean a shoulder and the brass into the opponent and press them back toward the edge.

name: Prism Brassring
description: Pierce the guard with the boss at the end of a long running step along the rim.

name: Brawledict
description: Walk the rim in a chain of steps and blows, each stride ending on a strike.

name: Interstice Knuckleplate
description: Cross the open rim in an instant and land a hook before the opponent can turn.

name: Steel Overhand
description: The school's rim blow, taught to all students, falls from a raised fist like a stone off the plateau edge.

name: Thunderclap Knockout
description: Drive a straight from a wide open stance with the breath held until the brass lands.

name: Squall Bandarch
description: Take one long pace over level ground to close or open the distance.

name: Prism Palmbar
description: Raise the fists and promise aloud not to give the edge of the stance to any blow.

name: Haemal Hooking
description: Chain sworn hooks across the open ground, speaking one vow for each blow.

name: Enshrined Fistbar
description: Turn a blow with a gust-like sweep of the forearm and return it as a cross.

name: Thrall Overhand
description: Open the fist over the opponent's arm and press it with the brass bar until it is pinned.

name: Nightmare Hooking
description: Speak an oath to one side and strike on the other as the opponent turns toward the sound.

name: Lordly Knuckleridge
description: Drive the boss through the guard from the open stance with the full weight of a sworn step.

name: Symphonic Studplate
description: Speak a sequence of vows as strikes, each fulfilled by the blow that follows it.

name: Feather Haymaker
description: Flash across open ground at the speaking of the oath and land the cross it names.

name: Dauntless Inferno Knuckleplate
description: The school's sworn blow, taught to all who take the oath, lands precisely on the line it has named aloud.

name: Haemal Brawl
description: Lead with the brass along a bearing fixed on the opponent's breastbone.

name: Slabsolace
description: Pace round the opponent keeping the bearing unchanged as the angle shifts.

name: Adamant Brassring
description: Keep the covering fists on the bearing so that every blow must meet them first.

name: Ruling Handfill
description: Tap the rim of the opponent's guard with the brass to knock their own bearing away.

name: Paramount Brassrim
description: Run hooks along the held bearing in quick succession, qi renewed on each.

name: Pallslab
description: Redirect an incoming blow along the bearing and send the answering fist after it.

name: Sigil Ringband
description: Bind the opponent's arm along the bearing with both brass fists and keep the line fixed.

name: Phantasm Brawl
description: Show a false bearing with the shoulders, then take the true one at the moment of the strike.

name: Majestic Brawl
description: Pierce the guard with the boss along the full length of the held bearing.

name: Destiny Uppercut
description: Run a sequence of blows that never lets the bearing slip from the opponent's centre.

name: Ringgrace
description: Flash down the bearing to the opponent's side and land a charged blow as the line closes.

name: Dauntless Vacuum Brassrim
description: The school's held-line blow, taught to every master, gathers the whole bearing into one boss thrust.

name: Steel Bandarch
description: Jab from an open stance with no covering hand, trusting the field to guard the rest.

name: Overhand Odyssey
description: Drift a pace to the side on a breath of qi, as a seed drifts on a draught.

name: Inviolate Handfill
description: Leave the arms loose and let the broad field alone turn blows off the body.

name: Brassring Verdict
description: Chain hooks across the opponent's open side with the field pushing each along.

name: Parity Knuckleplate
description: Let the forearm give way before a blow like grass in the wind and return a cross.

name: Tyrannous Studplate
description: Lean the broad field against the opponent's guard until their raised arms sink.

name: Radiance Haymaker
description: Drive the boss into the guard with the whole open stance committed behind it.

name: Hooking Crown
description: Move through open angles in a sequence that strikes once from each and never twice from the same.

name: Slabodyssey
description: Flash across the open field in one breath and land a cross before the opponent turns.

name: Famed Thunderclap Ringband
description: The school's blow, taught to all its students, spreads the field wide and draws it into one fist.

name: Splendid Knockout
description: Jab with the first word of the oath, a steady pulse of qi rising from the Core.

name: Wraithlike Uppercut
description: Step on a gust of Core qi pushed down through the legs.

name: Ironclad Palmbar
description: Hold the covering fists with the oath on the lips and a steady stream of Core qi in the arms.

name: Haemal Studplate
description: Swing the sworn hook with a strong pulse from the Core at the end of the arc.

name: Pall Knuckleridge
description: Read the bearing of a blow, turn it off with the forearm and return a fist from the Core.

name: Sigilring
description: Bind the opponent's arm in both rings and keep the grip sworn and steady with Core qi.

name: Pealstud
description: Rap the brass with a sudden gust from the Core to snap the opponent's aim aside.

name: Magnificent Knuckleridge
description: Drive the boss on a sworn thrust charged with Core qi through the guard's narrowest seam.

name: Knuckedict
description: Speak a vow for each blow of a sequence and feed each from the Core in turn.

name: Ringband Voyage
description: Flash to the opponent's flank on a burst of Core qi and land the sworn cross.

name: Valiant Squall Overhand
description: The school's sworn blow, taught to each student, binds an oath to Core qi and lands it in one fist.
